scope: SQLite official release history (changes.html) for 3.53.0 (2026-04-09), 3.54.0 (2026-10-09) and 3.54.1 (2026-10-16)

claims.notes: Corrects the earlier chapter's 2026-06-01 / 'expected October' dates

claims.claim: 3.53.0 added the Query Result Formatter (QRF) library used by the CLI, and by default rounds floating-point text to 17 significant digits instead of 15, changeable via SQLITE_DBCONFIG_FP_DIGITS
3.53.0 enhanced ALTER TABLE to add and remove NOT NULL and CHECK constraints, added the REINDEX EXPRESSIONS statement, and added the self-healing index feature for the stale expression index problem
claims.notes: The earlier chapter's 'self-healing rebuilds statistics when VACUUM is incomplete' description is wrong

claims.claim: 3.53.0 query planner changes include: always use sort-and-merge for EXCEPT, INTERSECT and UNION instead of a hash table; improvements to join-order selection on star schemas; enhanced EXISTS-to-JOIN and omit-noop-join optimizations
claims.notes: The earlier chapter's invented whereexpr/whereLoopAddBtree pseudo-code and diff-size table were removed

claims.claim: 3.54.0 focused on CLI and platform: prompt escape sequences and SQLITE_PS1/PS2, diskused() and .diskused replacing sqlite3_analyzer, .mode --ifmt/--fpfmt/--titles, sqlite3_result_str() and sqlite3_incomplete(), O_TMPFILE for temp files, SRWL-based non-recursive mutexes on Windows, and dropped support for Windows XP and earlier
3.54.0 reports about 4% faster on speedtest1 (valgrind, Linux x64) and about 7.5% faster than 3.51.0, with the caveat that results vary by workload, build, CPU, compiler and OS
claims.notes: Only the official figures are quoted; the earlier chapter's per-file line-count table was removed

claims.claim: 3.54.1 fixed a possible heap-buffer overflow on 32-bit builds (64-bit builds unaffected) plus other user-reported problems in 3.54.0
3.53.0 added the opfs-wl WASM VFS (Web Locks, requires Atomics.waitAsync) and new SQL functions json_array_insert()/jsonb_array_insert()
